# Country context contract fixtures

`country-bundle-moz-context.json` (v1 country bundle) and `page-bundle-country-moz-context.json` (v2 page bundle) are exact copies of `tests/fixtures/country_context/bundles/MOZ-country-bundle.json` and `MOZ-page-bundle.json` from the Narrative Engine repository at commit `b84eab1`, copied on 2026-10-14. The engine serialized them offline from its reference Mozambique snapshot, a Mozambique context test manifest with two events linked to the antiretroviral therapy finding and a mock provider. No network request or model call was made, and the prose is test output, not editorial content.

Both bundles include two `external_context` sources, one Results context paragraph and one Overview paragraph with optional `context_spans`: exact phrases of the claim text, each citing one `external_context` source the claim also cites. The Overview paragraph has no heading and also cites the structured source of the antiretroviral therapy count it states. Every other claim omits the key, as in every bundle without country context.
